app.name: Footprint Earth
app.description: Publish code-only owner footprints and privacy-thresholded visitor aggregates.
app.tagline: Remember where we met, without keeping coordinates
privacy.title: Privacy boundary
privacy.copy: The app collects no arbitrary coordinates, cities, free text, or device location. A map click resolves only to a bundled allowlisted code.
globe.title: Places where our paths have crossed
globe.drag: Drag to rotate · wheel to zoom
page.canvasAria: Rotate with drag or arrow keys, then click to select a country or region
selection.title: Choose a region
selection.regionUnavailable: Country level only for this location
selection.none: Drag the globe, then click to choose
guest.title: Public view
guest.copy: You see owner-published footprints and bucketed locations formed by at least three distinct members.
member.title: Leave a visitor footprint
member.copy: Up to eight distinct places per campaign, with at least 60 seconds between accepted submissions.
member.sent: Submission sent; it enters replay after a server envelope confirms it.
member.feedCopy: Members see only the region and date here, never the submitting Actor.
member.feedEmpty: No visible submissions in this campaign.
owner.title: Edit my public footprints
owner.empty: The owner has not published any footprints.
public.title: Visitor footprint overview
public.empty: No aggregate meeting the privacy threshold has been published.
diagnostics.title: Capacity and trust
admin.title: Footprint Earth controls
admin.publishCopy: A k=3 bucketed projection can be published only after complete history retrieval.
admin.campaignCopy: Rotation creates a new public Room. Old events remain, but do not enter the new campaign.
admin.grantOwnerOnly: Only an event from the server-reported Room owner Actor takes effect.
admin.auditEmpty: No accepted submissions in this campaign.
admin.membersEmpty: The member list is empty or unavailable.
admin.confirmCampaign: Create a new public Room and switch the active campaign? Old events will remain.
